sources.label: Baylor College of Medicine: Genetics & Genomics Graduate Program

deadlines.label: Final
deadlines.note: The admissions page describes 2027 entry. The portal gives these explicit dates but labels the academic year 2026–27; confirm with admissions. Late applications considered if space is available.

english.toefl: 5.0 for exams on or after January 21, 2026; 90 for earlier exams
english.note: University minimums; programs may require higher scores. Qualifying degrees can satisfy English proficiency, including an English-medium degree supported by a sealed/stamped registrar letter; see official testing policy.

applicationFee.note: No application fee; no waiver request is necessary.

requirements.note: Submit the application by the deadline; recommendations may arrive afterward.

funding.note: PhD students receive a stipend, full tuition remission and individual health insurance. Students pay matriculation, educational resource, graduation and student services fees; international students pay an additional fee. A 2027–28 stipend amount is not stated.

timeline.decisions: Offers extended February/March/April; respond by the date in the offer letter.
